bod-p01.claim: Never-setting light containing powers and darknesses, one within whom they end.
bod-p01.conclusion: The all-containing One is established before anything is said of bondage or practice.
bod-p01.inference: Setting needs an outside; nothing is outside it, so it never sets; light and dark both belong to it.
bod-p01.lore: anastamita (never-setting) light — no outside to set into.
bod-p01.next_pressure: Name this One own-nature of all beings (verse 2).
bod-p01.question: What contains both powers and darknesses?
bod-p01.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice
unresolved_terms: anta as both limit and abode — both kept

bod-p02.claim: He alone is all beings' own-nature, the supreme Lord; the host of things is His power in Lordship-form.
bod-p02.conclusion: Own-nature within, power without — one subject, two faces.
bod-p02.inference: Eva (alone) in both halves excludes any second: beings are He, things are His power shaped as sovereignty.
bod-p02.lore: svabhava equation: own-nature within, isvaratamayi power without.
bod-p02.next_pressure: Show power declining difference from its possessor (verse 3).
bod-p02.question: What is the Lord to beings, and beings' world to Him?
bod-p02.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice
unresolved_terms: isvaratamayi as power's form, not a second entity

bod-p03.claim: Power desires no difference from the power-possessor; their identity is eternal, as of fire and burning.
bod-p03.inference: Na vanchati (not even desired) rules out separation at the level of will; iva carries the ontology.
bod-p03.lore: vahnidahikayor iva — the stock nonduality simile.
bod-p03.next_pressure: Give the identical pair a name and a manner: Bhairava mirroring (verse 4).
bod-p03.question: Does power stand apart from its possessor?
bod-p03.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice
unresolved_terms: Desire personifies non-separation; no mechanism beyond the simile

bod-p04.claim: Bhairava's mark is world-bearing; the whole stands mirrored by power in His own self-seeing.
bod-p04.inference: Laksana (mark, not act) plus pratibimbitam (reflected, not made) exclude construction; mirror is His seeing itself.
bod-p04.lore: jagadbharaa as defining epithet; adarsa the instrument.
bod-p04.next_pressure: Introduce the goddess who owns the grasping (verse 5).
bod-p04.question: How does Bhairava bear the world?
bod-p04.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p05.claim: The supreme goddess, His alone, is eager for own-nature-grasping; her fullness fills all beings exactly.
bod-p05.conclusion: Desire terminates in His nature; fullness is exact — neither little nor excess.
bod-p05.inference: Tasyaiva (His alone) bounds belonging; utsuka (eager) aims only at svarupamarsana; nalpam na adhikam defines purnatva.
bod-p05.lore: para devi; purnatva as exact fullness.
bod-p05.question: What does Sakti want, and how much does she fill?
bod-p05.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p06.claim: God and goddess, always play-joy-eager, do varied creation-dissolution simultaneously, all-pervading.
bod-p06.conclusion: The world-process has a mood (play), not a goal; simultaneity replaces alternating ages.
bod-p06.inference: Nityam (always) fixes the mood; yugapad (at once) the timing; vibhuh (all-pervading) the scope.
bod-p06.lore: kridarasotsuka with yugapad — joy, not purpose.
bod-p06.question: In what spirit is the world made and unmade?
bod-p06.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p07.claim: Hard-to-accomplish = unsurpassed = autonomy = lordship = awareness-form: five terms, one referent.
bod-p07.conclusion: Difficulty is rank — what nothing else can do marks the highest, freest, most aware.
bod-p07.inference: Pure equation with no verb beyond 'is'; anuttara forces the rank reading of atidurghatakaritva.
bod-p07.question: What is autonomy?
bod-p07.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p08.claim: Limited light is the inert's mark; awareness differs from the inert since it is not measured.
bod-p08.conclusion: Immeasurability is the differentia; what cannot be bounded is not inert.
bod-p08.inference: Kila marks agreed ground; yatas na parimiyate gives the stated criterion — argument by criterion, not praise.
bod-p08.next_pressure: Stand creations-dissolutions as the autonomous one's nature (verse 9).
bod-p08.question: What distinguishes awareness from the inert?
bod-p08.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p09.claim: By own-power-distinction, creations-dissolutions — gone to own self — stand as the autonomous one's nature.
bod-p09.conclusion: Distinction-within-autonomy, movement-within-rest; they are stood, not made.
bod-p09.inference: Nijasaktyupabheda internalizes distinction; svatmagah denies departure; samsthitah (stood, durative) denies event.
bod-p09.question: Where do creation and dissolution go?
bod-p09.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p10.claim: In them: extreme variety up-down-across; worlds, their parts, pleasure-pain-mind.
bod-p10.conclusion: Outer cosmos and inner cosmos inventoried together before the cause is named.
bod-p10.inference: Three directions cover every spread; the list joins worlds-parts (outer) with pleasure-pain-mind (inner) — no inner/outer split.
bod-p10.next_pressure: Name the cause: non-knowledge of autonomy (verse 11).
bod-p10.question: How far does the variety reach?
bod-p10.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice
unresolved_terms: tesu refers back to verse 9's creations-dissolutions

bod-p11.claim: Non-knowledge of autonomy is described as autonomy itself — and that itself is terrifying samsara for the deluded.
bod-p11.conclusion: Samsara is autonomy mis-known, not a second thing.
bod-p11.inference: Hi equates (not explains); sa eva khalu identifies; vibhisaka qualifies only samsara-for-fools, never autonomy.
bod-p11.lore: aparijnana = svatantrya = samsara: ignorance as His freedom.
bod-p11.question: What is non-knowledge, and what is samsara?
bod-p11.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p12.claim: From grace-sap, from teacher-scripture, from the Lord's scripture — from whichever, arrival.
bod-p12.conclusion: Three doors, one arrival; the route is indifferent, arrival counts.
bod-p12.inference: Yasmat kasmat (from whichever) refuses ranking; repeated eva stresses grace and guru, scripture standing third.
bod-p12.lore: Ferrario on grace (saktipata); three doors, arrival however.
bod-p12.next_pressure: Name the arrival: full knowledge = liberation (verse 13).
bod-p12.question: By what way is it approached?
bod-p12.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice
unresolved_terms: upagatam leaves arrival's content unnamed — verse 13 names it

bod-p13.claim: Full knowledge of reality is liberation from the supreme Lord — fullness of the awakened, living liberation, remembered.
bod-p13.conclusion: Knowing = liberation = fullness = living freedom = recorded teaching: equated, not sequenced.
bod-p13.inference: Four terms, one referent; paramesatah is source-and-domain; sa smrta closes on transmission into memory-lineage.
bod-p13.question: What is liberation?
bod-p13.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p14.claim: Bondage and liberation do not differ from the Lord's nature; in truth, no difference in the supreme Lord.
bod-p14.conclusion: Non-difference stated twice — of the pair, and in the Lord — closing every gap the hymn opened.
bod-p14.inference: Paramesasvarupatah sources both; na bhidyete (they do not differ) plus na bhedo (no difference): doubling is emphasis; tattvatah bounds the claim to reality-level, leaving verse 11's terror standing phenomenally.
bod-p14.lore: Double negation; tattvatah reconciles verse 11 by level.
bod-p14.next_pressure: Close with the emblem and the injunction to contemplate (verse 15).
bod-p14.question: Do bondage and liberation differ?
bod-p14.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice

bod-p15.claim: Thus: trident-lotus bearing will, art, knowledge, power — Bhairava, all things' own-nature, to be contemplated.
bod-p15.conclusion: The hymn ends in dwelling, not departure; the close returns to verse 2's equation with the method attached.
bod-p15.inference: Ittham gathers the powers into one emblem; parisilyate (passive, durative) enjoins ongoing contemplative dwelling, not a rite to complete.
bod-p15.lore: sulambuja emblem; parisilyate as closing injunction; SOURCE.txt variant sarvabhavanam noted, T1's sarvabhavanam followed.
bod-p15.next_pressure: None — the arc closes; the colophon couplet names the tender-minded audience.
bod-p15.question: How is Bhairava to be held?
bod-p15.speaker: Abhinavagupta, teaching voice
unresolved_terms: asrita agrees with Bhairava; lotus symbolism not expanded
